entries.en: Added 1M context window for Opus 4.6 by default for Max, Team, and Enterprise plans (previously required extra usage)
entries.zh: Max、Team 和 Enterprise 计划默认为 Opus 4.6 添加 1M 上下文窗口（之前需要额外使用）

entries.en: Added `/color` command for all users to set a prompt-bar color for your session
entries.zh: 添加了`/color`命令，供所有用户为会话设置提示栏颜色

entries.en: Added session name display on the prompt bar when using `/rename`
entries.zh: 添加使用`/rename`时提示栏上显示会话名称

entries.en: Added last-modified timestamps to memory files, helping Claude reason about which memories are fresh vs. stale
entries.zh: 向内存文件添加了最后修改的时间戳，帮助 Claude 推断哪些内存是新鲜的，哪些是陈旧的

entries.en: Added hook source display (settings/plugin/skill) in permission prompts when a hook requires confirmation
entries.zh: 新增Hook需要确认时权限提示中的Hook来源显示（设置/插件/技能）

entries.en: Improved startup performance on macOS non-MDM machines by skipping unnecessary subprocess spawns
entries.zh: 改进非 MDM 管理的 macOS 机器的启动性能：跳过不必要的子进程启动

entries.en: Suppressed async hook completion messages by default (visible with `--verbose` or transcript mode)
entries.zh: 默认隐藏异步钩子的完成消息（加上 `--verbose` 或转录模式后可见）

entries.en: Fixed voice mode not activating correctly on fresh installs without toggling `/voice` twice
entries.zh: 修复全新安装后，语音模式需要切换两次 `/voice` 才能正确激活的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Claude Code header not updating the displayed model name after switching models with `/model` or Option+P
entries.zh: 修复了使用`/model`或 Option+P 切换模型后 Claude Code 标头不更新显示的模型名称的问题

entries.en: Fixed session crash when an attachment message computation returns undefined values
entries.zh: 修复了附件消息计算返回未定义值时会话崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash tool mangling `!` in piped commands (e.g., `jq 'select(.x != .y)'` now works correctly)
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 工具在管道命令中损坏 `!`（例如，`jq 'select(.x != .y)'` 现在可以正常工作）

entries.en: Fixed managed-disabled plugins showing up in the `/plugin` Installed tab — plugins force-disabled by your organization are now hidden
entries.zh: 修复了`/plugin`“已安装”选项卡中显示的托管禁用插件 - 由您的组织强制禁用的插件现在已隐藏

entries.en: Fixed token estimation over-counting for thinking and `tool_use` blocks, preventing premature context compaction
entries.zh: 修复思考和 `tool_use` 块的 token 估算过高，导致上下文过早被压缩的问题

entries.en: Fixed corrupted marketplace config path handling
entries.zh: 修复了损坏的市场配置路径处理

entries.en: Fixed `/resume` losing session names after resuming a forked or continued session
entries.zh: 修复了恢复分叉或连续会话后`/resume`丢失会话名称的问题

entries.en: Fixed Esc not closing the `/status` dialog after visiting the Config tab
entries.zh: 修复了访问“配置”选项卡后 Esc 未关闭`/status`对话框的问题

entries.en: Fixed input handling when accepting or rejecting a plan
entries.zh: 修复了接受或拒绝计划时的输入处理

entries.en: Fixed footer hint in agent teams showing "↓ to expand" instead of the correct "shift + ↓ to expand"
entries.zh: 修复了代理团队中的页脚提示，显示“↓ 展开”，而不是正确的“shift + ↓ 展开”

entries.en: Breaking change: Removed deprecated Windows managed settings fallback at `C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json` — use `C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json`
entries.zh: 重大更改：删除了“C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode\driven-settings.json”中已弃用的 Windows 托管设置回退 — 使用“C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\driven-settings.json”
